item_defect: D2-under is not truly underdetermined: two-decimal percentages with totals below 10,000 almost always identify the totals as the smallest consistent N, and both agents recovered the true totals exactly. The catalogue specified integer percentages for this variant; the bank used two decimals. Frozen scores stand; bank v2 must use integer percentages.
